label: SAM
terms_note: Free with a SAM.gov account; role-based daily request quota; US federal public data.

discovery.auth: api_key (personal public API key from SAM.gov Account Details)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (read-only Get Opportunities Public API) Confidence high (official docs opened).
auth: 1. Create a SAM.gov account → Account Details → generate the public API key (enter the password to view it; visible until you leave the page).

endpoints.notes: noticeId, title, solicitationNumber, type, postedDate, responseDeadLine, naicsCode, description link, pointOfContact — 'This API requires pagination'

reference.limits: - 'Request per day are limited based on the federal or non-federal or general roles'. - No offer-submission API — the notice states where to send offers (assist). - Free with a SAM.gov account; role-based daily request quota; US federal public data.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: SAM.gov public API key: sign in to SAM.gov → Account Details → generate the public API key (daily request limits depend on the account's role).

adapter.terms: US federal public data; request limits per day depend on the federal/non-federal/general role. Offers go to the contracting office as each notice instructs.

search_postings.note: Get Opportunities v2: notices posted in the last 364 days (postedFrom/postedTo are mandatory, MM/dd/yyyy, at most one year apart). query = title; category = NAICS code (ncode, up to 6 digits); offset is the page index ('Indicates the page index. Default offset starts with 0'). Award notices are included (type/baseType in raw); solicitationNumber, naicsCode, typeOfSetAside, pointOfContact, placeOfPerformance and the description link (raw.description, a URL needing the api_key) stay in raw. min_budget is not sent (no budget filter).

get_posting.note: The same search filtered by noticeid (only notices posted within the last 364 days can be found, since the posted-date window is mandatory).

not_offered.me: No key-introspection endpoint in the Opportunities API.
not_offered.submit_bid: No offer submission API; each notice says where to send offers (contracting office).
not_offered.credits: Daily limits depend on the account role; no quota endpoint.

evidence: host api.sam.gov: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 0/2 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
